summary: Adds randomized jagged subdivisions and displacements along vertex normals or a specified direction, commonly for terrain-like SOP geometry.

key_params.name: fixed
key_params.note: Use fixed bounds/behavior for the generated displacement.

key_params.name: vtxnms
key_params.note: Use vertex normals for displacement direction.

common_gotchas: The official docs caution that `divs` values around 1-3 are reasonable; higher values can create excessive geometry.
`vtxnms` overrides the explicit direction vector when enabled.
Seed controls reproducibility, so changing it intentionally changes the generated surface.
key_concepts: Fractal SOP subdivides and displaces geometry to create jagged, terrain-like variation.
Displacement can use an explicit direction vector or vertex normals through `vtxnms`.
`divs` controls subdivision depth and quickly increases geometry size.
`smooth`, `scale`, `seed`, and `fixed` control deviation shape, amplitude, reproducibility, and fixed-bound behavior.
